concerns.text: Plan Task 3.4 (bootstrap stability analysis, 1000 iterations on the full dataset, off-CI) has NO implementing research task. T012 only names it in a paper-stage handoff. Bootstrap stability of the reported metrics is a research-analysis deliverable (plan places it in Phase 3, not Phase 4 reporting), so deferring it wholesale to the paper pipeline leaves a plan element uncovered. Add a task (off-CI, like the fMRIPrep full run) that produces the stability artifact, or move it explicitly in the plan to the paper stage.

Plan Task 4.2 requires 'network diagrams' as a visualization deliverable; T009 produces only scatter plots and a bar chart. No task covers the network-diagram output. Either add it to T009 or record in the tasks doc that network diagrams are dropped/deferred with justification.

Spec US-2's independent test requires a metrics JSON containing 'edge_strength' joinable with behavioral data. T004 computes flattened edge strengths, but T005 (merge) and T008 (regression) describe only scalar network metrics; the downstream role of edge-level features (used, PCA-reduced, or excluded) is never stated, leaving FR-004's edge-strength deliverable ambiguous after computation.
